title: Responding to Coercion Scenario Simulator
description: A branching dialogue simulator where students apply a five-strategy framework for responding to coercion across friend, family, and early-dating scenarios and see realistic, non-punitive consequences.
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education

learningObjectives: Students apply the five-strategy framework for responding to coercion by choosing a response at each stage of an unfolding scenario and seeing a realistic consequence.

pedagogical.instructionalRationale: Applying strategies within an unfolding realistic situation is Apply-level, so a branching simulator is used instead of a static list, letting learners rehearse decision-making under social pressure with realistic, non-punitive consequences.
